source: &305 Your plastic food tray from...well, whenever it was, the yellow-brown mash still in it looks like it now has residents all of its own.
target: &305 这是你……不知什么时候用过的塑料餐盘。里面还剩着黄褐色的糊糊，看样子已经有东西在上面安家了。

source: &306 The stainless-steel shower hose supplies all of the water for the apartment.
target: &306 公寓里所有的用水，都由这根不锈钢淋浴软管提供。

source: Picked up: Plastic tray and Fork
target: 获得：塑料餐盘和叉子

source: &663 The panel by the door also controls the apartment's net connection, call-system and thermostat, as well as the door's locking.
target: &663 门边的面板不光控制门锁，还管着公寓的网络、通讯系统和温控器。

source: &664 If you could get inside it, you might be able to set off an emergency unlock.
target: &664 要是能打开面板，也许就能触发紧急开锁。

source: &391 Still not working.
target: &391 还是不行。

source: &665 Apparently I can't just wait for the problem to fix itself. Can't rely on anyone else...
target: &665 看来光等着，问题是不会自己消失的。也指望不上别人……

source: &309 The apartment's centralized systems speak to you more clearly than ever as your wetware joins with its systems.
target: &309 湿件接入公寓的集中控制系统后，你与系统之间的交流变得前所未有地清晰。

source: &310 You've already successfully made a connection with the door's panel. Better check your Trance hub to see if it can give you any answers.
target: &310 你已经成功连上了门锁面板。去迷境中转站看看，或许能找到答案。

source: &392 Huh...it broke...
&311 The flimsy plastic that the fork was made of wasn't up to the task of prising the panel from the wall. With better-quality tools, though...
target: &311 塑料叉子太脆弱，撬不开墙上的面板。不过，要是换件结实点的工具……

source: &393 Got it!
&315 While certainly sharp and strong, the tool's shape would prevent you from using it to pry the panel from the wall.
target: &315 这工具虽然锋利又结实，但形状不合适，没法用来撬开墙上的面板。

source: &316 The %s won't help you get inside the panel.
target: &316 用%s打开不了面板。

source: &317 The gaping black chute dominating the food machine's top half is where used trays and cutlery are deposited for recycling.
target: &317 食品机上半部那张黑洞洞的大口，是回收用过的餐盘和餐具的地方。

source: &318 The materials are melted down, and vacuum-formed into new utensils every time you order a meal. Some places use metal utensils, but down here in the poorblocks, it's all just plastic.
target: &318 每次点餐，机器都会熔化回收材料，再用真空成型做出新餐具。有些地方用金属餐具，但在底下的贫民区，只有塑料的份。

source: &319 The apartment's 'food' machine, which pipes your infrequent meals straight into your home in semisolid form.
target: &319 公寓里的“食品”机。你偶尔吃上一顿时，它就会把半固体的食物直接输送到家里。

source: &320 Your machine's been broken for a while, but you haven't noticed - you've been too busy trancing.
target: &320 机器已经坏了一阵子，可你一直没发现——你光顾着泡在迷境里了。

source: &321 Reaching your arm into the recycling slot can only end in tears.
target: &321 把胳膊伸进回收槽，准没好下场。

source: &330 You've gone to enough trouble to make it - putting it back into the machine would be a waste!
target: &330 费了那么大工夫才弄出来，再塞回机器里就白忙活了！

source: &322 With the way those monomolecular-carbon blades are made, they'd probably do a great deal of damage to the machine if you tried to recycle them.
target: &322 这种单分子碳刃实在太锋利，塞进去回收，多半会把机器弄得一团糟。

source: &323 The cable's made of silicon fiber-optic cable - nothing that the machine could recycle in its vacuum-press.
target: &323 这是硅质光纤电缆，机器的真空压机回收不了这种材料。

source: &324 You wonder briefly if it would count the soap as a flavouring, rather than something to make utensils from.
target: &324 你不由得想，机器会不会把肥皂当成调味料，而不是做餐具的材料。

source: &327 You load the memory module into the machine. After a few moments it begins to glow, indicating a successful connection.
target: &327 你把记忆模块插进机器。过了一会儿，模块亮了起来，说明连接成功。

source: // Plastics: RECYCLED
target: // 塑料：已回收

source: &331 The machine thinks for a moment, then displays a message:
target: &331 机器思考片刻，显示出一条消息：

source: &282 // !ERROR![[// user safety settings enabled[// unable to produce metal utensils due to danger of harm[// To change this, please seek administrator permission[[Thank you for your cooperation![<T.H.E. Foods - your future, on a plate>
target: &282 // ！错误！[[// 用户安全设置已启用[// 金属餐具可能造成人身伤害，无法生产[// 如需更改，请获取管理员授权[[感谢您的配合！[<T.H.E.食品——把未来端上餐桌>

source: // Metal: RECYCLED
target: // 金属：已回收

source: &333 The lower slot is where the food comes out. Anything being recycled needs to be thrown into the top of the unit.
target: &333 下面的槽口是出餐口。要回收东西，得从机器上面投进去。

source: &341 A bottle of 'soap' sits on the shelf in the bathroom.
target: &341 浴室的架子上放着一瓶“肥皂”。

source: &395 Eeww...slimy...
Picked up: Bottle of 'Soap'
target: 获得：一瓶“肥皂”

source: &396 HNNNnnngh...
&666 Guess I'm not as strong as I thought. I'm not getting out this way...
target: &666 看来我没自己想的那么有力气。这条路是出不去了……

source: &343 The large drain in the floor means that cleaning the room can involve as little as hosing everything down. 'Cheap' is the way it's done in here.
target: &343 地上有这么大的排水口，打扫房间时用水管冲一遍就行。这地方的一切，讲究的都是“省钱”。

source: &344 Maybe if you had a couple of days, you'd be able to cut through it. Unfortunately, neither your patience nor your physical strength stretches quite that far.
target: &344 花上几天工夫，也许真能剪开。可惜你的耐心和体力都撑不了那么久。

source: &345 Careful, anything you drop down there could be lost forever.
target: &345 小心，东西掉下去，可能就再也拿不回来了。

source: &667 One of the lockers where I keep the few things I've got in meatspace.
target: &667 我在肉身世界就那么几件家当，都放在这些柜子里。

source: &668 Nothing in here...
target: &668 里面什么都没有……

source: &268 I've never been one to tidy things away, and it's not a habit I'm about to take up now.
target: &268 我从来不爱收拾东西，现在也不打算改。

source: &669 I usually keep clothes in here. Looks like I need to go to the support office to get more printed.
target: &669 这里平时放衣服。看来得去救济处再打印几件了。

source: &354 A tangle of exposed fiber-optic cables runs from floor to ceiling. You suspect they have them like this to make it more unpleasant to live here.
target: &354 裸露的光纤电缆乱糟糟地从地板一直通到天花板。你怀疑，他们故意弄成这样，就是为了让人住得不舒服。

source: &355 Unfortunately, wetware like this needs conductive or metal wiring to connect through. These are just fiber-optics.
target: &355 可惜，这种湿件得接上能导电的线路，比如金属线。这些只是光纤。

source: &356 You're not sure how this would work with the cable.
target: &356 你不知道这东西能怎么用在电缆上。

source: &400 Mm...nah. I already washed this week.
target: &400 嗯……算了。这星期已经洗过澡了。

source: &357 Thus, your long-standing enmity with the shower is resolved.
target: &357 就这样，你与淋浴之间的宿怨总算了结了。

source: &358 Rinsing it won't help.
target: &358 用水冲也没用。

source: &670 The vent cover above the door. It lets the air in and keeps the vermin out.
target: &670 门上方的通风口盖板。放空气进来，把害虫挡在外面。

source: &671 I can't get a grip to open it. Not like I could fit through there, anyway...
target: &671 没地方下手，打不开。反正我也钻不过去……

source: &361 With the cutters, you'd probably only succeed in ruining the grate, rather than removing it from the wall.
target: &361 用剪线钳只会把格栅剪坏，拆不下墙上的盖板。

source: Picked up: Steel Grille
target: 获得：钢制格栅

source: &401 If I keep randomly cutting cables, I'm going to end up electrocuted eventually.
target: &401 再这么乱剪电缆，迟早把自己电死。

source: &672 Exposed fiber-optics everywhere. I think they deliberately do this to make it less pleasant to live here.
target: &672 到处都是裸露的光纤。我看他们就是故意弄成这样，让人住得不舒服。

source: &673 Even if I cared that much about the apartment's rules, the sign's fixed to the wall.
target: &673 就算我真那么在乎这些公寓规定，告示也是钉在墙上的。

source: &403 'Tenancy Rules: City Housing Support.'
target: &403 “租住规定：市住房救济处。”

source: &404 'This housing is provided as is by the City Department of Social Welfare,'
target: &404 “本住房由市社会福利局按现状提供，”

source: &405 'until such time as you are able to secure employment.'
target: &405 “供您居住至找到工作为止。”

source: &406 'Basic facilities are provided within.'
target: &406 “室内配有基本生活设施。”

source: &407 'Since your stay is temporary, please do not damage...'
target: &407 “鉴于您只是暂住，请勿损坏……”

source: &408 Temporary, hah. I've been here for two years now.
target: &408 暂住，呵。我都在这儿住了两年了。

source: &674 Even if I could see out, it's not a nice view - hundreds of other sconto apartments in the barrel.
target: &674 就算能看出去，也没什么好风景——筒楼里还有几百间同样的廉价公寓。

source: &675 The darkness is supposed to encourage people to move out. Not me, it just makes Trancing easier.
target: &675 他们想让人嫌太暗，早点搬走。对我可没用，这样更方便泡迷境。

source: &368 It doesn't matter what tools you use - your years of trancing have left you too weak to stand any chance of removing the shutters from the window.
target: &368 用什么工具都没用。多年沉迷迷境，你的身体已经虚弱得不可能拆下窗上的遮板了。

source: &676 The window frame is welded-in. Even if I could open it, it'd be a 150 metre drop to the bottom.
target: &676 窗框是焊死的。就算能打开，下面也是足足150米。

source: &677 The way out - still standing in my way.
target: &677 出口——还是牢牢挡着我的路。

source: &678 Normally, staying in the apartment would be ideal, but now that I have no choice about it...
target: &678 平时能一直待在公寓里就再好不过了，可现在没得选……

source: &372 It's full of blue overalls, the kind provided by the city to the unemployed. Made out of a cotton-paper blend, they are mulched and recycled into new clothing rather than cleaned.
target: &372 里面全是蓝色连体服，就是市里发给失业者的那种。这种棉纸混纺衣服不用清洗，弄脏后打成浆，再回收做成新衣服。

source: &409 Euch, no!
target: &409 呕，才不要！

source: &410 Last time I reached into the pile, there was stuff growing in it.
target: &410 上次把手伸进去的时候，里面都长东西了。

source: &373 It won't benefit from being served up in a tray.
target: &373 把它端在餐盘里也没什么用。

source: &374 Making things clean is not a habit you've acquired.
target: &374 你可没养成爱干净的习惯。

source: &411 I don't think I can open it by myself.
target: &411 靠我自己恐怕打不开。

source: &412 It's not just stuck, it's locked.
target: &412 不只是卡住了，是锁上了。

source: &413 Making it slippery isn't going to work.
target: &413 弄滑一点也打不开。

source: &414 Realistically, I'm not going to get the whole door open with a fork.
target: &414 说实在的，一把叉子怎么可能撬开整扇门。

source: &415 I need to aim smaller.
target: &415 得找个小点的地方下手。

source: &416 Maybe if I had a couple of years to cut little holes out of it...
target: &416 要是花上几年，一点点剪出小洞，也许……

source: &417 How's that gonna get it open?
target: &417 这样怎么可能打开？

source: &418 There are bigger things to worry about than laundry at the moment.
target: &418 现在有比洗衣服更要紧的事。

source: &419 I'm likely to lose anything that goes in there.
target: &419 东西放进去，多半就拿不回来了。

source: &679 I'm not sure *when* I got this out of the machine. It's still soggy, though.
target: &679 我都不记得是什么时候从机器里拿出来的了。不过还是湿乎乎的。

source: &420 Mm...nah. I'm not that hungry.
target: &420 嗯……算了。我还没饿到那个地步。

source: Picked up: Trophy
target: 获得：奖杯

source: &269 The shower curtain glows an eerie, yet somehow soothing blue. Your project must have finished its final stages...
target: &269 浴帘泛着幽蓝的光，诡异，却又莫名让人安心。你的培养计划应该已经完成最后阶段了……

source: &682 It may take up the entire bathroom, but the still is totally worth it.
target: &682 虽然占了整个浴室，但这台培养器绝对值了。

source: &683 By growing my own wetware at home, I'll never need to leave the apartment again...unless something like this happens.
target: &683 在家自己培养湿件，就再也不用出门了……除非碰上今天这种事。

source: &337 You remove the gelatinous clump of semiorganic wetware you've been cultivating in the still. It looks like it's grown enough to be usable by now.
target: &337 你取出培养器里那团胶状的半有机湿件。看起来已经长到能用了。

source: Picked up: Wetware
target: 获得：湿件

source: &684 The still is empty - it'll take at least a few hours to grow another batch of wetware.
target: &684 培养器空了。至少还得等几个小时，才能长出下一批湿件。

source: &685 The seed colony of wetware already in the still will start to grow soon - it doesn't need any help.
target: &685 培养器里的湿件种群很快就会开始生长，不用我帮忙。
